'''''Sparganium angustifolium''''' is a species of flowering plant in the [[Typhaceae|cat-tail family]] known by the common names '''floating bur-reed'''<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |access-date=2014-10-17 |df= }}</ref> and '''narrowleaf bur-reed'''.<ref>{{PLANTS|id=SPAN2|taxon=Sparganium angustifolium|accessdate=24 November 2015}}</ref> It has a [[Circumboreal Region|circumboreal distribution]], occurring throughout the northern latitudes of the Northern Hemisphere. It is an [[aquatic plant]], growing in water up to 2.5 meters deep. Its habitat includes acidic, low-nutrient freshwater bodies such as ponds, lakes, slow-moving streams, and ditches. It can become abundant, practically covering the surface of the water. It is a perennial herb producing a floating stem with long, narrow, flattened leaves which can be quite long, sometimes reaching over two meters. It is [[Plant sexuality|monoecious]], individual plants bearing both male and female [[inflorescence]]s. These are spherical, the male inflorescence a ball of [[stamen]]s and the female inflorescence a ball of developing fruits.
